headline: Veer Global Infraconstruction announces details for its 2026 rights issue
hook: Micro-cap rights issue for retail radar
summary: Veer Global Infraconstruction has released the schedule, pricing, allotment details, and entitlement ratio for its upcoming 2026 rights issue. Rights issues allow existing shareholders to purchase additional shares at a discount to the market price. The company operates in the infrastructure and construction sector as a micro-cap entity. Indian retail investors holding the stock need to review the entitlement ratio and corporate action dates to decide whether to subscribe or renounce their rights.
why_it_matters: Existing shareholders must decide whether to buy or renounce rights.
